claude_proposed_widenings.name: area.shape.line
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Lightning Bolt creates a 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line area of effect. The area attachment's shape field is closed to { kind: 'sphere'; radiusFeet: number }. A line variant is needed: { kind: 'line'; lengthFeet: number; widthFeet: number }. Without this, the attachment cannot be encoded honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A stroke of lightning forming a 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line blasts out from you in a direction you choose.

discrepancies: no content/lightning_bolt.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
